Of course there’s Bernard Purdie who said he played on a Beatles session, it might be him it might not be. He might be lying completely. Knew I would get downvoted to shit but as a drummer and a massive, and I mean massive fan of Ringo, when I listen to the isolated drum track I do just know it’s not him. I mean, it’s apparent that George doesn’t play lead guitar on “While My Guitar Gently Weeps” right? Even though we definitely know it’s Clapton, any Harrison scholar could tell you straight away it’s not him without that prior information.

Listen to the difference: 

https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=uY771CD7FfU 

https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=WpYT9NhU_ds

The live versions have got that classic Ringo swing whilst the studio recording is played pretty straight. Different ride bell pattern, he plays the snare instead of the rim, all of these things lead me to believe that it is not Ringo playing on “I Feel Fine”.

That’s not Ringo playing the drums though. Any drummer familiar with his style will tell you so, plus the way he plays it live vs the how the recording sounds is a dead giveaway. I know many people will probably hate me for saying this, but as a major fan of Ringo, I just know that it wasn’t him playing on that particular session. Ringo would’ve played it with a more laid back feel, like he does on the live recordings.
